upstream_provenance.advisory_fixed_release_note: The advisory carries no 'before X' prose, so the first patched release is resolved from the OSV record rather than parsed from a sentence. OSV lists exactly two affected versions, version-3.43.0 and version-3.43.1, and its GIT range fixed event names 43fa051ec7c5a7d89e1f5f541a5cd34d53e07422, which is the release commit titled 'Version 3.43.2' dated 2023-10-10 and touches only manifest and manifest.uuid. The corrective code change is the separate commit 3736d874229135abecb935d938346dee5429196a dated 2023-10-09, which touches src/json.c and test/json101.test. Both are correct under their own semantics: OSV names the release that first carries the fix, this bundle names the change that made it. The shipped tree is version-3.43.0, which precedes 3.43.2, so the environment does not carry the fix.
